# R2.9a — egress/containment residual (half A): endorse-resume, amend→budget, fork custody

Ticket `docs/tickets/115_R2.9__egress-containment-legs.md` (seq 115),
split `R2.9a`/`R2.9b` at the ticket's pre-registered seam (`## Notes`;
manifest `## Plan extensions` 2026-10-07) — R2.9 is the round's largest
ticket. Stacked on `svitali/harnessharness-r2.8` (#114); ADR-0340.
Offline-only: every cell is `fixture`-verified — no live/staging
environment is touched or claimed.

**Requirement ids:** DF-S1.12-1 · DF-S1.12-2 · DF-S2.4-1 · R-2.8.2 ·
R-2.8.3 · R-2.8.4 · BL-18.

## What landed

**DF-S1.12-1 — verify pass → DONE.** `decide_egress` runs the normative
order executable (mode_guard → attribution → deny rules → non_public
guard → protocol/port/method → allow rule → approval_cache →
default_unmatched); attribution-token channel (`deny{unattributed}`
fail-closed); `security.egress.{requested,decided}` durable;
narrowing-only approval cache keyed `H(host∥port∥protocol∥method∥scope)`;
`network.calls` charged at the wire point post-`committed`;
credential-binding sentinel slot; `dns` resolver with consume-once
re-resolution; `non_public_destinations` declared-check at gate and wire;
`approved_host_body` declared as a `residual_channels` member (its
content-by-readers closer is R-2.8.2's C2 stage → R2.9b).

**DF-S1.12-2 — DONE.** `amend()`/`AmendmentDiff` mint fresh `version_id`s
basis/authority/scope-checked; `security.containment.amended` is durable
*before* the wire on `endorse_gate`'s `allow_lease` leg; dispatch writes
the amended policy back onto the live `EnvHandle`
(`apply_amended_containment` — record and handle never diverge, CC3);
`hh-results` lifts it into `annotations_from_ledger.containment_amended[]`.
`resources → BudgetNode`: five `hh.env.*` dimensions registered
(ADR-0340 D1), `resource_budget_spec` maps all eight `ResourceLimits`
members to hard caps, provision allocates a **pool child under the run's
durable root** (`control.budget.allocated`, never `manifest.budget` —
ADR-0340 D2); no root ⇒ typed `BudgetRefused`; widening refuses (CC9);
fork/replace children allocate their own node.

**DF-S2.4-1 — DONE.** (a) the `net_egress` route landed at CAP.3; this
run lands (b) the ask-endorsement ingress and (c) the fork rebind call
site:

- (b) `EgressMediator::endorse_gate` is the gate-stage endorsement:
  `deny`/`more_info` ⇒ `decided{deny, monitor}` terminal; `allow_once`
  request-only; `allow_lease` ⇒ `amend` + amended row + cache insert +
  `GateAllow{decided_by: monitor, amended_policy}` (ADR-0340 D3).
  `dispatch.rs::egress_ask_state` folds the durable prefix — an
  unanswered pending re-suspends behind the same `permission_decided`
  wakeup minting nothing; a final `decided{allow|deny}` on the pending's
  `permission_id` re-enters at `endorse_gate` (never a second
  `requested`/pending trail — ADR-0340 D4). The respond surface's
  decided row omits `effect_id` for a `net_egress` pending — the
  endorsement never claims the monitor's `(effect_id, attempt)` gate
  slot (I-H7; ADR-0340 D6) — and `authorize` skips re-minting an
  identical recorded verdict.
- (c) `EmbedService` holds the kernel-owned `CredentialBroker`
  (`DenyAllResolver` default + `set_credential_resolver`);
  `rebind_credentials_for_fork(store, lease, broker, parent: &EnvHandle,
  child_id)` runs at both fork legs (`work.rs::fork{env: snapshot}`
  cross-run; `envops::env.derive{fork_snapshot}`) — fresh placeholders,
  preserved expiry ceilings, `security.credential.bound` rows on the
  child's run, non-derive edge refused typed (LT-09; ADR-0340 D5).
